description: Convert PlayerEntry.tsx and CoachEntry.tsx to editable tables with empty-row-to-add pattern, inline editing, and a download template button. Also add capacity warning to CoachAssignment.tsx.
steps: Rewrite packages/frontend/src/pages/lead/PlayerEntry.tsx to be an editable table. Remove the '+ Add Player' button and the separate add form. Instead, each existing row should have inline-editable cells (name, number, primary position, secondary position, required evaluations). Add an empty final row at the bottom of the table - when the user types data into it, it creates a new player. Keep the Upload CSV button. Add a 'Download Template' button that generates and downloads a CSV file with headers only: name,number,primary_position,secondary_position,required_evaluations (no data rows). Keep the delete action on each row.

Rewrite packages/frontend/src/pages/lead/CoachEntry.tsx to be an editable table following the same pattern. Remove the '+ Add Coach' button and separate add form. Each existing row should have inline-editable cells (name, email, max players). Add an empty final row for adding new coaches. Keep the Upload CSV button and Get Invite Link button. Add a 'Download Template' button that generates and downloads a CSV with headers only: name,email,max_players (no data rows). Keep the delete action and role column.

Update packages/frontend/src/pages/lead/CoachAssignment.tsx to show a capacity warning. After loading players and coaches data, calculate: totalEvalSlots = sum of all coaches' maxPlayers values, totalRequiredEvals = sum of all players' requiredEvaluations values. If totalEvalSlots < totalRequiredEvals, display a prominent warning banner (yellow/amber background, warning icon) explaining that there are not enough eval slots to meet the player minimum ratings. Show the numbers: 'Coaches can perform X evaluations but Y are required to meet all player minimums.'
acceptance_criteria: PlayerEntry page has no '+ Add Player' button
PlayerEntry table has an empty final row that creates a player when data is entered and user leaves the row or presses Enter
PlayerEntry has a 'Download Template' button that downloads a CSV with headers: name,number,primary_position,secondary_position,required_evaluations
Existing player rows are editable inline with save/update on blur or Enter
CoachEntry page has no '+ Add Coach' button
CoachEntry table has an empty final row that creates a coach when data is entered
CoachEntry has a 'Download Template' button that downloads a CSV with headers: name,email,max_players
Existing coach rows are editable inline
CoachAssignment page shows a warning when sum of coaches' maxPlayers < sum of players' requiredEvaluations
The frontend builds successfully with npm run build -w @player-eval/frontend
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/PlayerEval && npm run build -w @player-eval/frontend
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/PlayerEval && npx playwright test
findings: Build passes cleanly. All 10 Playwright tests pass (1 skipped as expected - the manual add test is guarded with test.skip). The unused React import warning does not cause build failure due to JSX transform. The editable tables use onBlur with relatedTarget check to only save when focus leaves the new row entirely.
